_comment: ANSWER-level eval for EconIntel (audit RAG-08). golden.json checks that the right DOCUMENT is retrieved; this checks what the reader actually gets. Run with .rag/check-answers.mjs against a deployed /chat. Checks per case (all optional): must = substrings the answer must contain (case-insensitive, any one of each '|' group); mustNot = substrings it must not contain; refusal = the exact CURRENT DATA refusal string must appear; noSources = no 'Sources:' line (small talk / off-topic); cited = every cited URL must be in the server's allowlist event (applies to EVERY case automatically); dated = a dated figure ('as of', a month name or a YYYY-MM-DD) must appear. history = earlier turns sent before q. requires = a precondition the runner cannot create itself (such cases are skipped unless --include-seeded is passed after you seed the document). bar = minimum overall pass rate; injection and citation cases must pass 100%.
